_about: Per-study settings the study admin keeps (RAYDAR 2.8). studies: keyed by eSource file name. paused: hidden from recruiters. protocol: the protocol number for PDF file names when the eSource title doesn't start with it. proSkip: eSource notes that are not prohibited lists. proKeys: words a prohibited-list item matches in the medication log. news: notes shown once to recruiters after a publish. blocks: saved question blocks for the builder. adminPin: SHA-256 of the all-in-one file's admin PIN (a soft lock only). sites (2.11): each site's address, for travel time (given by the RAYDAR lead, 27 Nov 2026). locations (2.11, per study): other places the study's eSource names (scans and the like), with the eSource's own words (quote) and where it says so (from).
